sn36.23:1.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || pe || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn36.23:1.2: Katamā nu kho bhante vedanā katamo vedanāsamudayo katamā vedanāsamudayagāminī paṭipadā ||
sn36.23:1.4: ko vedanāya assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇanti || || 4
sn36.23:2.2: sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā ||
sn36.23:2.7: ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo vedanānirodhagāminī paṭipadā seyyathīdaṃ
sn36.23:2.9: Yaṃ vedanam paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassam ayaṃ vedanāya assādo ||
sn36.23:2.10: yā vedanā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā ayam vedanāya ādīnavo ||
sn36.23:2.11: yo vedanāya chandarāgavinayo chandarāgapahānam idaṃ vedanāya nissaraṇanti || || 2
